fusions.name: Burst Main
fusions.desc: Fires a high-pressure slug of water that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hydrostatic Round
fusions.desc: Fires a crushing round of compressed water at a target up to 10 tiles away that deals 32 damage, ignores its armour and hits harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at full reach.

fusions.name: Recoil Jet
fusions.desc: Fires a jet of water behind you that throws you 4 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Building Pressure
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
